_comment: Copy next to your private data and edit the paths. Keep the real config out of this public repo.

benchmarks.source: Name the benchmark source here - it is printed on the Benchmarks sheet

targets_xlsx: C:\path\to\WLCA_Targets.xlsx  (sheets Targets, GLA_Breakdown, PM_Structure - private; optional)

site.C1_note: Lump sum per m2 GIA - state the source

branding._comment: Optional and private: fonts, colours (hex without #) and logo for Dashboard / Compare. Omit for neutral defaults.
groups: 8 hex colours: substructure, superstructure, facade, finishes, FF&E, services, external works, site
modules: 5 hex colours: A1-A3, A4, A5, B4, C1-C4
basis: 5 hex colours: modelled, assumed, benchmarked, site, contingency
